entries.title: Workspace package absent from install
entries.root_cause: The workspace configuration excludes modules/ephemeris-core, so pnpm cannot resolve the workspace dependency @cedar-astrolabe/ephemeris-core required by the console package. Add the module to pnpm-workspace.yaml.

entries.title: Workspace package absent on release branch
entries.root_cause: The workspace configuration excludes modules/ephemeris-core, so pnpm cannot resolve the workspace dependency @cedar-astrolabe/ephemeris-core required by the console package. Add the module to pnpm-workspace.yaml.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later release job runs on a newer runner with a different Node version and install flags.

entries.title: Workspace package absent during release verification
entries.root_cause: The workspace configuration excludes modules/ephemeris-core, so pnpm cannot resolve the workspace dependency @cedar-astrolabe/ephemeris-core required by the console package. Add the module to pnpm-workspace.yaml.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later tag verification runs a filtered install after a separate workspace inspection step.

entries.title: Orbit label rounding test fails
entries.root_cause: The orbit label formatter truncates the calculated altitude instead of rounding it, causing its boundary test to fail. Correct the formatter's rounding logic.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The workspace dependency resolves and installation completes; a later unit test fails on an incorrect formatted value.
